card.name: Linking words in ancient tradition passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, to, from, in and who, and the word ancient, in web text about ancient history, myth, religion or traditional culture. The word comes just before a lineage, a ruler, a deity or a custom.

modes.label: Origin and descent links
modes.description: Words like of, to or from that link a person to a lineage, ruler or deity.
modes.example: It is nationalistic in that its leader is the Emperor, who is descended<< from>> Amaterasu, the sun-godd
